img.1.description: A wide, dark forest-green graphic split into two zones. On the left, a small lowercase white serif wordmark 'garner' sits above a three-line white serif headline reading 'Choose your doctor with confidence'. On the right, a cluster of overlapping circular and oval vignettes contains flat, stylized illustrations of people: an older man with glasses in a teal shirt beside a woman with dark hair, a smiling woman in blue scrubs, a man in a white coat with a stethoscope, and a woman with brown hair in a green top. The vignettes overlap each other and bleed toward the right edge of the frame.
img.1.title: Garner 'Choose your doctor with confidence' illustrated share card
img.1.usage_note: Use as a social/OG share card, a link-preview thumbnail, or a supporting illustration card where a calm, trust-oriented healthcare message is needed alongside a brand wordmark. Works well at wide aspect ratios (roughly 1.9:1) and in contexts where the headline can remain legible at small sizes.

img.10.description: A 64x64 raster image showing a stethoscope drawn in blue tones against a flat, medium-green background. The chest piece (diaphragm/bell) sits at the upper right as a small gray-silver disc with a darker center. From it, light-blue tubing curves down and around in a wide U-shaped loop across the lower half of the frame, then rises to the left where it meets a darker, near-black section of tubing that forms the headset/binaural bend at the upper left. A small warm orange-tan accent appears at the top-left end of that dark tubing. The whole subject is rendered with visibly blocky, stair-stepped edges, consistent with a very small source raster or a rasterized vector icon. No text, no wordmark, and no legible lettering appear anywhere in the image.
img.10.title: Pixelated Blue Stethoscope Icon on Green Field
img.10.usage_note: Use as a small decorative or supporting icon in healthcare, clinical, provider, or medical-data contexts — for example a feature bullet, a card thumbnail, a list item marker, or a section accent. It reads clearly at small sizes and communicates 'clinical / provider / care' quickly.

img.11.description: Square raster image (source dimensions 64 x 64 px, not animated, downscaled for preview) showing a single centered pictogram of a medical bag or briefcase. The bag body is a wide rounded rectangle in muted olive-to-khaki brown tones, with a slightly lighter highlight along its left edge and a subtle darker band across the lower third. A dark brown arched handle rises from the top center of the bag. Centered on the bag face is a thin cream-colored circular ring enclosing a thick, equal-armed cream plus/cross. Rendering is flat and low-detail with soft, slightly blurry edges consistent with a very small source resolution; there is no gradient shading, no cast shadow and no internal texture beyond the broad tonal bands described. No text, lettering, numerals or wordmark are visible anywhere in the frame.
img.11.title: Brown Medical Bag Icon with Cream Cross in Circle
img.11.usage_note: Use as a small decorative or supporting icon in healthcare-cost, benefits or care-navigation content, for example as a bullet or feature-list glyph beside an employer-facing value statement. It works best at small sizes as a secondary visual cue rather than as a focal image.

img.12.description: A dark green rounded-square field containing a centered white lowercase 'g' with a circular bowl and a lower loop. The background appears mostly solid dark green, possibly with a subtle gradient. Two small white horizontal marks are faintly visible near the top edge; their intentionality is uncertain due to low resolution. No other readable text or imagery is present.
img.12.title: Green rounded-square app icon with white lowercase g
img.12.usage_note: Use when a compact brand mark or app icon is needed for Garner Health-related contexts, such as app listings, favicons, avatars, or small card thumbnails, based on the supplied occurrence context.

img.13.description: A circular seal centered on a black background. The seal is rendered in white/light gray line art. Around the outer ring, all-capital text reads 'CITY OF' on the left, 'PORTLAND' along the top, 'OREGON' on the right, and '1851' at the bottom. Inside the ring is a detailed vignette with a standing figure, a staff or pole, and landscape/water/trees elements; exact details are small and not fully legible at this scale.
img.13.title: City of Portland Seal / Partner Logo
img.13.usage_note: Use as a partner/credential/logo mark in a partner-logo row, trust badge, or location/affiliation context when the City of Portland seal is relevant and the supplied alt/context supports that use.

img.14.description: A single horizontal wordmark lockup centered on a flat black field. The primary line reads 'ADVANCE' in heavy, bold, italic uppercase letterforms; the leading 'A' is stylized as a set of parallel diagonal slashes/stripes rather than a conventional letterform. A small superscript 'TM' sits at the upper right of the word 'ADVANCE'. Directly beneath, right-aligned to the end of the primary line, is a second line reading 'AUTO PARTS' in a smaller, bold, italic uppercase sans-serif. The entire mark is rendered in a single medium-gray tone against the black background; there is no other imagery, border, or decoration.
img.14.title: Advance Auto Parts gray wordmark lockup on black
img.14.usage_note: Use as a third-party brand reference mark in a logo wall, partner/customer strip, or brand-reference sheet where a monochrome, low-emphasis treatment is required. Suitable for dark or neutral backgrounds that match the gray-on-dark contrast seen here, and for documentation or design-library reference of the mark's lockup and proportions.

img.15.description: A centered, monochrome gray logo lockup on a solid black background. At top is an abstract mark made of three angled, ribbon-like strokes forming a stylized zigzag or M shape. Below is the large uppercase wordmark MOHAWK in a serif-style face, followed by a small registered trademark symbol. Beneath that is the smaller uppercase sub-wordmark INDUSTRIES, INC. in a sans-serif-style face. The lockup is surrounded by generous black negative space.
img.15.title: Mohawk Industries Logo Lockup on Black
img.15.usage_note: Use when displaying the Mohawk Industries corporate logo as a standalone brand mark in a logo wall, partner/customer list, or brand attribution context, after verifying rights and relationship.

img.16.description: A photograph of a woman standing in a field at sunset. She is seen from behind, facing left, with her hair down and wearing a light-colored top. The sun is low on the horizon, creating a warm golden glow and a silhouette effect. Tall grass or crops fill the foreground, and the sky transitions from bright yellow near the sun to softer orange and blue tones above.
img.16.title: Woman in a field at sunset
img.16.usage_note: Use as a full-bleed or contained hero image when a warm, aspirational, outdoor-lifestyle mood is needed. Suitable for travel, wellness, or brand-story sections where the subject matter is secondary to atmosphere.

img.17.description: A gray geometric mark resembling a stylized M sits to the left of a two-line uppercase wordmark reading METAL above EXCHANGE. The logo elements are gray on a solid black background. The lockup is centered with wide margins.
img.17.title: Metal Exchange logo lockup on black background
img.17.usage_note: Use as a dark-background logo lockup for Metal Exchange when the black field is acceptable or can be removed/composited. Suitable for brand identification, partner/logo-wall placements, or dark-themed layouts, subject to rights and context.

img.18.description: A single-line, horizontally centered wordmark reading 'Optum' set in a heavy, rounded sans-serif, rendered in flat medium gray on a plain white field. The initial 'O' is a perfect circular ring with a thin counter; the following letters ('p', 't', 'u', 'm') share the same weight and rounded terminals. The descender of the 'p' drops below the baseline of the remaining letters. The wordmark occupies roughly the middle third of the frame horizontally and about a third of the height vertically. There is generous, even white negative space on all four sides, with no other graphic elements, icons, taglines, borders, or texture.
img.18.title: Optum gray wordmark on white background
img.18.usage_note: Use as a reference or display element for the Optum brand lockup when illustrating healthcare-payer, insurer, or benefits-network context (for example, a partner/provider logo row, a benefits-navigation article, or a comparison graphic). It works as a clean, low-distraction card thumbnail or inline mark on a white or very light background.

img.19.description: A horizontal wordmark logo displaying the text "Benefitfocus" in a bold, rounded sans-serif typeface, accompanied by a registered trademark symbol (®) placed at the upper right after the final letter. The logo is solid gray on a plain white background.
img.19.title: Benefitfocus wordmark logo
img.19.usage_note: Use this logo when referring to Benefitfocus as a company, product, or partner. Ensure sufficient contrast and clear space around the mark.

img.2.description: A smartphone mockup displays the Garner Assistant chat interface. The conversation asks for an orthopedic surgeon in Lyme, CT, specifies hip replacement, and returns three in-network hip orthopedic surgeon profiles with names, distances, star ratings, review counts, and complication-rate badges. The phone sits on a pale mint-green rounded rectangle against a black background.
img.2.title: Garner Assistant chat screen with orthopedic surgeon results
img.2.usage_note: Use as a product screenshot to demonstrate the Garner Assistant search and provider-matching experience, especially in a card or inline context on a healthcare or benefits website.

img.20.description: A horizontal wordmark reading 'garner' in lowercase, dark teal/green, heavy rounded sans-serif letterforms, with a small superscript 'TM' at the upper right. The preview shows the wordmark on a black background; the background may be transparent or a dark matte. No other graphic elements are visible.
img.20.title: Garner Health wordmark logo (dark teal)
img.20.usage_note: Use as a brand identifier on light or neutral backgrounds where the dark teal wordmark has sufficient contrast. Suitable for website headers, footers, brand pages, and light-themed collateral.

img.21.description: A standalone logo lockup on a flat, uniform dark field: the word 'Mercy' set in light gray, followed immediately to the right by a plus/cross-shaped mark whose arms overlap the right side of the final letter. No other elements, no photographic content, no visible layout, interface, or frame.
img.21.title: Mercy wordmark with overlapping cross mark on a dark ground
img.21.usage_note: Suitable as a logo tile in a partner/customer trust row, a sponsor or endorsement attribution line, a social-proof grid, or a small identity element on a card — with the mark kept secondary to any headline or message. Works in a dark-theme logo strip where every mark is treated monochrome for consistency.

img.22.description: A horizontal logo lockup on a plain white field: a solid mid-gray five-pointed star glyph with a notch cut from its lower-right point, followed by the word 'MarketStar' set in a mid-gray sans-serif, with a very small superscript trademark symbol after the final letter. The mark is centered with generous white space around it.
img.22.title: MarketStar gray star-and-wordmark logo on white

img.23.description: A single centered monogram composed of interlocking geometric letterforms that read as 'O' and 'U' in solid medium-gray against a flat black background. The 'O' is a rounded octagonal ring; the 'U' is a squared-off U shape that overlaps the lower-right of the 'O'. No additional text, icons, or imagery is visible. The mark occupies a small central area, leaving large black negative space around it.
img.23.title: Interlocking OU Monogram on Black — Rasterized SVG Preview
img.23.usage_note: Use as a partner/sponsor logo mark in a logo grid, partner list, card, badge, or dark-background lockup when a monochrome OU mark is appropriate and the relationship is authorized. Suitable for small-scale identification if legibility is preserved.

img.24.description: A square abstract illustration composed of layered geometric forms, including a central circular shape, overlapping rounded rectangles, and triangular wedges. Colors include deep indigo, violet, warm coral, orange, and pale cream. The composition is centered and balanced, with soft gradients and flat color fields. No text, logos, or recognizable objects are visible.
img.24.title: Abstract Geometric Illustration with Warm and Cool Gradient Shapes
img.24.usage_note: Suitable for decorative backgrounds, section dividers, feature card imagery, or abstract brand accents in digital and editorial layouts.

img.25.description: The supplied preview renders as a uniform white field across the full frame. No shapes, strokes, gradients, textures, figures, text, logos, or edges are discernible at the delivered resolution. The original is reported as a 605x512 SVG that was rasterized and downscaled to 512px for preview; the resulting image is visually empty.
img.25.title: Untitled white-field illustration (no legible content recovered)
img.25.usage_note: Cannot be recommended on visual grounds. If the file is confirmed to be a genuine white or near-white vector graphic (e.g., a background wash, a white-on-transparent mark, or a matte layer), it could serve as a neutral background or spacer surface behind overlaid DOM content. Verify the source file before relying on it.

img.3.description: A medium shot of a woman with shoulder-length brown hair wearing a navy button-front blouse, standing behind a light wood desk in a bright white room. She looks off to her left with a slight smile, her right hand resting on a thick stack of white papers. On the desk in the foreground lie a dark-screened smartphone and a dark-screened tablet, both flat, each showing a faint greenish circular mark. Behind her are white walls, a large leafy plant in a gray pot at left, a second leafy plant and a wooden crate at right, and bright daylight entering from the left. The image is presented with rounded corners against white.
img.3.title: Bright office lifestyle photo: woman in navy blouse at desk with papers, phone and tablet
img.3.usage_note: Use as a supporting lifestyle image in a benefits, healthcare-cost, or workplace-wellness context where a calm, non-clinical, human tone is wanted; works well as a card or inline image beside copy about reimbursement, paperwork, or everyday administration.

img.4.description: A stylized, flat-vector-looking illustration of the United States on a light, softly rounded panel. The country is a solid dark green landmass with thin darker outlines dividing the contiguous states, plus Alaska and Hawaii drawn smaller at the lower left. Dozens of small white circular dots are scattered inside the landmass across most states, roughly evenly but irregularly distributed. The panel behind the map is a very pale blue-white and its outer corners are rounded, leaving the extreme canvas corners outside that panel reading as blank/light. The map is not axis-aligned with the panel: it appears rotated a few degrees counter-clockwise, so the Pacific Northwest sits low-left and the Northeast sits high-right, with the Maine/New England tip approaching the panel's upper-right rounded corner and the Florida tip near the lower-right. Alaska and the Hawaiian island chain sit in the lower-left area, partly outside the main landmass. No legend, labels, roads, topography, or data keys are visible; the dots have no stated scale or meaning in the pixels themselves.
img.4.title: Dotted dark-green U.S. coverage map on a rounded pale panel
img.4.usage_note: A left- or right-side supporting graphic beside a coverage, footprint, or database-scale paragraph; a card or panel image inside a feature grid; a section divider illustration; a background motif behind short overlaid copy if transparency is confirmed.

img.5.description: A woman with brown hair in a bun, wearing a white lab coat, is seated at a desk in an office or lab environment, viewed from behind and slightly to the left. She faces a computer monitor displaying line graphs and data charts. A large teal circular ring graphic is overlaid behind and around the monitor. The background includes glass partitions, blurred office elements, and a dark chair. The image has rounded corners and a black background visible at the corners, suggesting a masked or cutout composition.
img.5.title: Woman in lab coat reviewing data charts on monitor with teal ring overlay
img.5.usage_note: Use when illustrating healthcare data analytics, clinical review, provider insights, or technology in a medical or office setting. Suitable for sections about data-driven recommendations or outcomes.

img.6.description: A rectangular graphic on a dark teal background. A lighter teal diagonal shape occupies the upper-left corner. Two rounded-square portrait photos are arranged side by side in the upper half. Left portrait: a man with dark hair and mustache, wearing a black crew-neck shirt, against a gray wood-siding background. Right portrait: a woman with long blonde hair, wearing a blue collared shirt, against a green foliage background. Below each portrait, centered white text gives a name, role, and company: 'James Schull', 'Head of Product', 'Garner Health'; 'Lauren Chucko', 'SVP, Client Success', 'Garner Health'.
img.6.title: Garner Health team profile graphic with James Schull and Lauren Chucko
img.6.usage_note: Use when introducing two named team members with roles and company affiliation in a compact horizontal layout; suitable for website team sections, presentation slides, or video thumbnails where the surrounding context explains the video or section.

img.8.description: Wide static raster graphic on a solid dark green/teal background. Top-left: white lowercase wordmark "garner". Lower-left: left-aligned bold sans-serif headline in four lines: "How Primary Care Referrals Decide Specialist Quality and Cost"; "How Primary Care Referrals Decide" is white and "Specialist Quality and Cost" is bright mint/teal green. Right side: a stylized diagram with a large dark circular node containing a plus/cross symbol, connected by branching lines to three stacked rounded-rectangle card/list icons; the top card and its connector are bright mint/teal green, while the middle and bottom cards and connectors are muted dark green. The three card icons each contain a small circular dot and two short horizontal lines. No other readable text or logos visible.
img.8.title: Garner Health editorial header: How Primary Care Referrals Decide Specialist Quality and Cost
img.8.usage_note: Suitable as a widescreen article header, blog card media, newsletter header, or social share image when the article matches the baked-in headline. The dark background and self-contained composition work well in dark or neutral layouts, or as a framed card on light backgrounds. Do not crop the logo or any part of the headline; keep safe margins around "garner" and "Quality and Cost." If cropping is necessary, reduce or crop from the far right before touching left-side text. For narrow or square placements, use a different layout because the composition is horizontally split.

img.9.description: A flat, cartoon-style illustration of a magnifying glass tilted diagonally, handle at the lower left and lens at the upper right. The lens is a cream/off-white circle framed by a thick blue ring with a lighter blue highlight along its upper-left edge. Inside the lens sit three ascending green bars (short, medium, tall, left to right) and, to the left of the bars, a small dark-green silhouette of a person with one arm raised. The handle is a light blue tapered bar with a darker blue segment where it meets the rim. The whole graphic sits on a flat olive/forest-green field that fills the square frame.
img.9.title: Magnifying glass icon over ascending bar chart with small figure
img.9.usage_note: Use as a small supporting icon next to benefit, savings, analysis, benchmarking or 'find the data' style copy, or as a compact card thumbnail where a magnifier-plus-chart metaphor fits. Works best at small sizes where its simple shapes stay readable.

mark.description: A square, 256x256 raster image containing a solid dark green circular field that fills the frame. Centered on the circle is a single large lowercase letterform 'g' rendered in an off-white / very pale mint tone. The letterform has a closed circular bowl at the top with a round counter, and a lower loop with a wide oval counter, giving the glyph a stacked, figure-eight-like silhouette. The stroke weight is heavy and uniform, with rounded terminals and no serifs. No other text, iconography, imagery or border is visible.

mark.title: Dark Green Circular Mark with White Lowercase 'g'
mark.usage_note: Use as a compact brand mark or avatar-style identifier where a single-letter glyph on a solid circular field is needed: favicon/touch-icon reference, small inline brand chip, list or card thumbnail, or as a reference swatch when matching a dark green + off-white palette. Works best at small to medium sizes where the single glyph stays legible.

primary.description: A horizontal wordmark reading 'Garner' in black serif type on a white background. The word begins with an uppercase G followed by lowercase arner. No additional symbols, taglines, or graphic elements are visible.

primary.title: Garner wordmark logo
primary.usage_note: Use when a compact, horizontal brand wordmark is needed for identification in light or dark contexts, especially where a theme-adaptive SVG can inherit currentColor. Suitable for website headers, footers, brand kits, or authorized partner/press materials.

wordmark.description: A tightly cropped raster preview of a horizontal, single-line lowercase wordmark spelling 'garner'. Letterforms are heavy-weight and rounded, with a very dark desaturated teal-green ink, set against a flat dark field. A small superscript-sized glyph sits at the upper right, immediately after the terminal 'r'. No icon, monogram, container shape, tagline or additional lines are present.

wordmark.title: Lowercase Teal Wordmark 'garner' (Single-Line, No Symbol)
wordmark.usage_note: Use as the primary identity mark in a header, or as a small credibility mark in footers, press/boilerplate blocks, partner lists (only where an approved relationship exists) and presentation title areas. It is an identity asset rather than a marketing creative; if reused inside a card, banner or hero, it functions as a branding element within that layout, not as the content itself.

constraints.rule: No shadows. Every measured surface records shadow null, and the kit has no shadow token. Keep buttons, cards, and bands flat.
Marketing buttons are pills: radius.full. Do not apply derived radius.button. The only radius.sm button is the single solid.000000 control.
surface.band.014036 is the only full-bleed section fill in the saturated green. Do not stripe the page with it.
CTA green is button.shared-017660.fill, not derived surface.accent and not surface.brand. surface.brand is a render sample (#047464) and is not the measured button fill.
Do not paint sections with derived surface.canvas. Measured grounds are surface.band.ffffff and, once, surface.page.
button.ghost-2d62ff.label is not a brand accent. It appears on underline ghost controls only; do not use it as a section, card, or headline color.

Hero headline is white on the photograph. Do not apply the type.headline color binding (text.primary) there. Interior headlines are forest green, which has no text token — do not recolor them to text.primary or text.band.ffffff.
Headlines and nav stay sentence case. Do not add tracked uppercase eyebrows; none are on this page.
Dominant cards are borderless (measured border width 0) with radius.card and space.card.padding. Do not add a stroke to that variant.
Quote region stays text-only. Do not add portraits to those cards.
The closing green pair are panels inside a white section, not extra section backgrounds. Do not emit them as surface.band entries.

diagnostics.reason: A blue accent is present in the DOM but is not a brand surface. Left out of palette_application so it is not deployed as marketing color.

diagnostics.observation: Resource-card greens and the left closing panel are saturated green fields inside a white section. They are not in the section background sequence.
diagnostics.reason: Cannot assign a surface token without an exact measured match. Do not invent surface.band names for them.

diagnostics.observation: The capture repeats the hero photograph beneath the footer.
diagnostics.reason: Not established as a designed footer image versus a capture artifact. Not written as a composition rule.

diagnostics.observation: Derived and unused as on-page facts: surface.canvas, surface.accent, surface.brand.subtle, radius.button, type.display, type.eyebrow, type.stat, and the neutral/primary ramps.
diagnostics.reason: Provenance is derived or render, and this homepage does not show those values as the measured system. surface.brand specifically disagrees with the measured CTA fill.

signature_compositions.structure: Full-bleed lifestyle photo; left-aligned white serif headline in two short period-ended lines; one white pill CTA beneath. A white rounded header bar sits over the photo: wordmark, sentence-case links, outline Login pill, solid green Book a demo pill.

signature_compositions.name: Four audience columns
signature_compositions.structure: On surface.page, four equal columns: small green icon, serif title with an arrow, two lines of sans body. No cards, no photos.

signature_compositions.name: Trust line and logo marquee
signature_compositions.structure: One centered line, then a horizontal run of partner wordmarks. Site motion tokens motion.animation.marquee-animate-left and motion.animation.marquee-animate-right exist for this kind of ticker.

signature_compositions.name: Centered headline, dark video well
signature_compositions.structure: Centered serif headline, then one large dark rectangular media well. On this capture the well is an empty cookie-blocked frame, not a designed illustration.

signature_compositions.name: Alternating media and copy rows
signature_compositions.structure: Three rows on white: rounded media left / copy right, then copy left / media right, then media left / copy right. Copy is a forest serif headline, sans body, and one quiet pill or text CTA. Media is a map, a phone UI, or a photograph.

signature_compositions.name: Forest statement band
signature_compositions.structure: One full-bleed surface.band.014036 band. Rounded photo left, white serif headline and body right, one pill in button.solid-1b8470.fill.

signature_compositions.name: Edge-cropped quote ticker
signature_compositions.structure: Centered serif heading, then two rows of flat pale quote cards running off both edges. Card is quote plus name only.

signature_compositions.name: Resources three-up
signature_compositions.structure: Left serif title, right text link. Three cards: image or green graphic on top, title beneath, underlined text link under the title.

signature_compositions.name: Closing split panels
signature_compositions.structure: Inside a white section, two adjacent saturated panels. Left darker green, white serif headline, white pill. Right brighter green, white serif headline, darker pill. One CTA each.

typographic_posture.case_posture: Sentence case everywhere observed — nav, headlines, CTAs, card titles. No tracked uppercase eyebrows. The hero is two short lines, each closed with a period.
signature_moves: Hero headline uses type.headline (Stix Two Text, measured from the h1) in white on the photograph, left aligned, two short lines with terminal periods.
Interior section headlines use type.title in the same serif; they read forest green, not the token's text.primary color binding.
Smaller serif titles measured as card.shared-29c267.font (Stix Two Text 24/500) against Open Sans body (type.body).
